title: 2021 AMC 10A Problem 18
statement: Let \(f\) be a function defined on the set of positive rational numbers with the property that \(f(a\cdot b)=f(a)+f(b)\) for all positive rational numbers \(a\) and \(b.\) Suppose that \(f\) also has the property that \(f(p)=p\) for every prime number \(p.\) For which of the following numbers \(x\) is \(f(x) < 0?\)

solutions.text:
Repeated use of the functional equation gives \(f(p^e)=ef(p)=ep\) for every prime \(p\) and positive integer \(e.\) Also, \[f(a)=f\left(\frac ab\right)+f(b),\] so \(f(\frac{a}{b})=f(a)-f(b).\)

Evaluating the choices by prime factorization, \[ \begin{aligned} f(\frac{17}{32})&=17-5\cdot2=7,\\ f(\frac{11}{16})&=11-4\cdot2=3,\\ f(\frac{7}{9})&=7-2\cdot3=1,\\ f(\frac{7}{6})&=7-2-3=2,\\ f(\frac{25}{11})&=2\cdot5-11=-1. \end{aligned} \] Only the final value is negative.

Thus, E is the correct answer.
